package application

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
)

// A4.0 negative fixture: the approval module mutating the documents module's
// base table directly. This is the write shape hgcrossmodule was blind to —
// UPDATE <foreign table> SET matches neither FROM nor JOIN, so before the
// write scan landed this file produced zero findings.
//
// The read below is the shape the guard already caught, kept alongside so the
// fixture also proves the two are reported distinctly rather than one
// swallowing the other.
//
// See scripts/testdata/guard-fixtures/README.md.
func markPublished(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, id string) error {
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
		`UPDATE documents SET status = 'published' WHERE id = $1`, id); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
		`INSERT INTO document_revisions (document_id, status) VALUES ($1, 'published')`, id); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx,
		`DELETE FROM document_comments WHERE document_id = $1`, id); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	row := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT status FROM documents WHERE id = $1`, id)
	var status string
	return row.Scan(&status)
}
